subtitle.source: Paste a Hugging Face reference, a URL, or a path on this host.
subtitle.yaml: Write the model configuration by hand. Nothing is auto-detected.

form.uriHint: Press Enter to import. LocalAI picks the backend from the source unless you choose one.
form.customKeyValueHint: Add custom key-value pairs for advanced configuration.
form.backendHint: Narrow the list by what the model does, then pick one. Leave it on auto-detect and LocalAI decides. Entries marked "manual pick" are never auto-detected.
form.backendErrorHint: Could not load the backend list. Auto-detect only.
form.backendNotInstalled: This backend isn't installed yet. Submitting import will download it first.
form.modelNameHint: Custom name for the model. If empty, the filename will be used.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Leave empty to use default description
form.quantizationsHint: Preferred quantizations (comma-separated). Leave empty for default (q4_k_m).
form.mmprojQuantizationsHint: Preferred MMProj quantizations. Leave empty for default (fp16).
form.embeddingsHint: Enable embeddings support for this model.
form.modelTypeHint: Model type for transformers backend. Examples: AutoModelForCausalLM, SentenceTransformer, Mamba.
form.schedulerTypeHint: Scheduler type for diffusers backend. Examples: k_dpmpp_2m, euler_a, ddim.
form.cudaHint: Enable CUDA support for GPU acceleration.
form.manualPickTooltip: Auto-detect won't route to this backend. Pick it here if you know that's what you want.
form.yamlHint: Written to the models folder as it is. Nothing is detected or downloaded.

fit.fits: Fits in the {{free}} that is free.
fit.tight: Close to the {{free}} that is free.
fit.over: More than the {{free}} that is free.

estimate.diskShort: More than the {{free}} free on the models disk.

toasts.started: Import started. Progress is shown below.
toasts.backendsLoadFailed: Could not load backend list — using auto-detect only
toasts.modalityClearedBackend: Cleared backend selection — it wasn't in the {{label}} group.

found.title: What LocalAI can tell
found.untouched: Nothing is downloaded or contacted yet. LocalAI reads the repository when you import.
found.backendAuto: Chosen when the import starts, from what the source holds.

preview.title: Request preview
preview.note: This is what the form sends. LocalAI returns no preview of the model configuration: it is written after the import starts. Write YAML lets you write the configuration yourself.

checks.heading: Checks
checks.note: Only what can be known before the import starts.

done.title: The model is imported
done.text: It is registered with LocalAI. Open it in Models, or start a chat with it.

bar.ready: Imports {{ref}} and writes its model configuration. The size is known once it starts.

ambiguity.title: More than one backend could run this
ambiguity.tts: This looks like a text-to-speech model. Pick one of the backends below to continue.
ambiguity.asr: This looks like a speech-recognition model. Pick one of the backends below to continue.
ambiguity.embeddings: This looks like an embeddings model. Pick one of the backends below to continue.
ambiguity.image: This looks like an image-generation model. Pick one of the backends below to continue.
ambiguity.reranker: This looks like a reranker or classifier model. Pick one of the backends below to continue.
ambiguity.detection: This looks like an object-detection model. Pick one of the backends below to continue.
ambiguity.other: This looks like a {{modality}} model, but LocalAI cannot pick a backend by itself. Pick one of the backends below to continue.
ambiguity.notInstalled: Not installed. LocalAI downloads it first.
ambiguity.useInstallTitle: Use {{name}}. LocalAI will install it first.
